pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

skill_baselines.recipe: Equal prior team-box role resampling; exchangeable current bullpen; analytic existing team NB

team_model.version: team-nb-decay-sp-v2 (starter adjustment: fip value, k 300, beta 1.0 x expected share; tuned on 2025)

layout: inning 1 to 9 (9 is the ninth and later)
runners before it (first base 1, second 2, third 4, added)
win_table.note: Home win share (percent) of the simulated games that reached each state before a plate appearance, shrunk toward pooled states. The page charts the real game through it; in-game snapshots stay exact.

bookkeeping.method: prior-date pitch-count pools (pitcher pools only when at least 25 PA) plus a shrunk hit-by-pitch rate by batter hand, pitcher and batter

pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

53bff4fde0dce5ce505d70fe5fbd3be13de9e9dc.sample_selection: projected: favorite wins, nine innings, closest to the median of team runs, team hits and both starters' outs, strikeouts and pitches; then most central high-scoring, low-scoring and upset worlds

win_table.note: Home win share (percent) of the simulated games that reached each state before a plate appearance, shrunk toward pooled states. The page charts the real game through it; in-game snapshots stay exact.

contact.method: batted-ball shape, fielder and distance from real prior balls in play of the same kind (own batter with at least 6, else league by batter hand); double plays from ground-ball double plays, sacrifice flies from sacrifice flies

bookkeeping.method: prior-date pitch-count pools (pitcher pools only when at least 25 PA) plus a shrunk hit-by-pitch rate by batter hand, pitcher and batter

pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

skill_baselines.recipe: Equal prior team-box role resampling; exchangeable current bullpen; analytic existing team NB

contact.method: batted-ball shape, fielder and distance from real prior balls in play of the same kind (own batter with at least 6, else league by batter hand); double plays from ground-ball double plays, sacrifice flies from sacrifice flies

bookkeeping.method: prior-date pitch-count pools (pitcher pools only when at least 25 PA) plus a shrunk hit-by-pitch rate by batter hand, pitcher and batter

pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

contact.method: batted-ball shape, fielder and distance from real prior balls in play of the same kind (own batter with at least 6, else league by batter hand); double plays from ground-ball double plays, sacrifice flies from sacrifice flies

bookkeeping.method: prior-date pitch-count pools (pitcher pools only when at least 25 PA) plus a shrunk hit-by-pitch rate by batter hand, pitcher and batter

pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

skill_baselines.recipe: Equal prior team-box role resampling; exchangeable current bullpen; analytic existing team NB

contact.method: batted-ball shape, fielder and distance from real prior balls in play of the same kind (own batter with at least 6, else league by batter hand); double plays from ground-ball double plays, sacrifice flies from sacrifice flies

bookkeeping.method: prior-date pitch-count pools (pitcher pools only when at least 25 PA) plus a shrunk hit-by-pitch rate by batter hand, pitcher and batter

pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

b26dbd351d66f0cd40968b316d89cb8efe6c6dc0.sample_selection: projected: favorite wins, nine innings, closest to the median of team runs, team hits and both starters' outs, strikeouts and pitches; then most central high-scoring, low-scoring and upset worlds

skill_baselines.recipe: Equal prior team-box role resampling; exchangeable current bullpen; analytic existing team NB

team_model.version: team-nb-decay-sp-v2 (starter adjustment: fip value, k 300, beta 1.0 x expected share; tuned on 2025)

layout: inning 1 to 9 (9 is the ninth and later)
runners before it (first base 1, second 2, third 4, added)
win_table.note: Home win share (percent) of the simulated games that reached each state before a plate appearance, shrunk toward pooled states. The page charts the real game through it; in-game snapshots stay exact.

bookkeeping.method: prior-date pitch-count pools (pitcher pools only when at least 25 PA) plus a shrunk hit-by-pitch rate by batter hand, pitcher and batter

pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

e269e127d11411aaded993f377c270156752db07.sample_selection: projected: favorite wins, nine innings, closest to the median of team runs, team hits and both starters' outs, strikeouts and pitches; then most central high-scoring, low-scoring and upset worlds
